fields.Participants: Controller, Consolidation (VS-17), Finance (VS-17.4), AP (VS-15), Treasury (VS-18), Audit (VS-21), External Auditor

workflows.name: Lease Accounting Period-End Close, Reconciliation & Disclosures

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-reconciliation; disclosure-pack auto-generation; maturity-analysis engine; audit-support pack
Controls: - CTL-676: system reconciled to GL/AP/cash/FA monthly; eliminations validated; PFRS 16 disclosures complete; reviewed & auditor-supported
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (R2R/consolidation), VS-15 (AP), VS-18 (treasury), VS-35 (FA), VS-21 (audit), W4417 (engine), W4424 (elimination), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation-break risk**: lease-system vs GL mismatch → close delay/finding; mitigated by monthly reconciliation
- **Disclosure-incompleteness risk**: missing PFRS 16 disclosure → auditor/SEC finding; mitigated by disclosure template & checklist
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting engine (W4427); GL/consolidation (VS-17); AP/cash (VS-15/VS-18); FA (VS-35); BI (VS-28); disclosure templates; audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting close the period — run final engine (W4417), reconcile lease-accounting system to GL ROU/liability, to AP/cash (VS-15/VS-18), and to FA register (VS-35)

Lease Accounting/Consolidation run intercompany eliminations (W4424), validate consolidation, and prepare the **PFRS 16 disclosures** (maturity analysis, total cash outflow, ROU additions, depreciation/interest expense, variable/short-term/low-value expense, extensions/terminations/modifications)
Controller/Audit review & sign off, support external-audit (VS-21), and file the audited FS with SEC (links VS-22/VS-79)

fields.Participants: Master Data (VS-29), Lease Admin (VS-42), Legal (VS-100), Real Estate (VS-97), IT (VS-27)

workflows.name: Lease Data Governance, Master & Contract Repository

Automation Opportunity: - Canonical lease repository with contract-link; data-quality rule-engine; duplicate/version detection; legal-hold integration
Controls: - CTL-676: canonical repository maintained; data-quality checked; abstract-vs-contract validated; records retained (VS-88); SoD-governed access
Cross-references: - links to VS-29 (master data), VS-42 (lease admin), VS-100 (legal), VS-88 (records), W4411 (abstract), W4427 (system), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: incomplete/stale abstracts → wrong recognition; mitigated by data-quality checks & abstract-vs-contract match
- **Version-control risk**: superseded contracts retained as current; mitigated by status/version control & source-link
System Touchpoints: - Lease repository (W4427); master data (VS-29); contract/legal (VS-100/VS-42); records (VS-88); IT (VS-27); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Master Data maintain the **lease repository** — canonical lease record (abstract W4411, source contract, entity, asset class, dates, payments, options, status) linked to contract-management (VS-100/VS-42) and master data (VS-29)
Lease Accounting run data-quality checks — completeness, duplicate detection, abstract-vs-contract match, key-field validation — and remediate exceptions
Lease Accounting/Legal retain contracts & audit trail (VS-88), manage legal-hold (VS-100), and govern access per SoD (VS-29/W4428)

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), EA (VS-113), Controller, BI (VS-28), Consolidation (VS-17), TBM (VS-135)
fields.Trigger: System lifecycle; policy change (W4409); integration need

Automation Opportunity: - Integrated PFRS 16 engine; auto-journal to GL; AP/FA feed; consolidation feed; index-data integration
Controls: - CTL-676 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Administration, Compliance & Optimization Analytics (PA-148.3).)
- CTL-676: platform security-assessed (VS-27.3); integrated to GL/AP/FA/consolidation; engine config tested; cost governed (VS-135); reconciled (W4425)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-113 (EA), VS-28 (BI), VS-135 (TBM), W4409 (policy), W4425 (close), W4431 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integration-gap risk**: lease system not integrated to GL/AP/FA → manual rekey/error; mitigated by end-to-end integration & reconciliation (W4425)
- **Engine-config-error risk**: wrong engine config (rate/method) → systematic mis-statement; mitigated by config testing & dual review
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting platform; GL (VS-17); AP (VS-15); FA (VS-35); consolidation (VS-17); BI (VS-28); index feed; security (VS-27.3); TBM (VS-135)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/EA/IT select/configure the lease-accounting platform — PFRS 16 engine (PV, depreciation, interest, remeasurement, elimination), multi-entity/multi-currency, integration to GL (VS-17), AP (VS-15), FA (VS-35), BI (VS-28)
IT/EA integrate & test — GL posting, AP/cash feed, FA-register link, consolidation feed, index/CPI feed — and migrate the portfolio (W4426)
IT/Lease Accounting govern the platform — security (VS-27.3), change (VS-27.1), TBM cost (VS-135), roadmap — and optimize on analytics (W4431)

fields.Participants: Audit (VS-21), Controller, Lease Accounting, Compliance (VS-22), External Auditor, Governance (VS-36)
fields.Trigger: Audit cycle; control review; SOX-style scoping

workflows.name: Audit, Internal Control & SOX-Style Compliance for Leases

Automation Opportunity: - Control register linked to lease workflows; SoD/access analytics; sample-testing automation; finding-remediation workflow
Controls: - CTL-676: risk-based control set over the lease lifecycle; SoD & dual review; key controls tested; findings remediated; reported to Audit Committee
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-36 (governance), VS-22 (compliance), W4410–W4414 (lifecycle), W4425 (close), internal-controls-matrix
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control-gap risk**: key control missing at high-risk points (identification, modification, disclosure) → mis-statement; mitigated by risk-based control set
- **SoD-breach risk**: same person abstracts & posts → override; mitigated by SoD & dual review
System Touchpoints: - Audit (VS-21); controls register (internal-controls-matrix); lease-accounting (W4427); governance (VS-36); compliance (VS-22); GL (VS-17)
Time Estimate: - ~weeks per audit cycle; annual control review

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Audit design the lease-accounting internal-control set — identification (W4410), abstracting review (W4411), rate/term/payment review (W4412), classification (W4413), recognition (W4414), modification (W4418), close/disclosure (W4425), SoD, access
Audit test key controls (SoD, dual review, reconciliation, disclosure completeness), sample-test transactions, and assess SOX-style design & operating effectiveness
Audit/Controller remediate findings, support external-audit (VS-21), and report to Audit Committee/Governance (VS-36)

fields.Participants: Tax (VS-79), Lease Accounting, Lease Admin (VS-42), AP (VS-15), Treasury (VS-18), Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Lease payment; tax review; BIR change
fields.Volume: Lease payments across ~205+ leases × multiple periods

Automation Opportunity: - Tax-treatment rule-engine per lease; AP WHT-gate; DST contract-trigger filing; BIR eFPS integration
Controls: - CTL-676 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Administration, Compliance & Optimization Analytics (PA-148.3).)
- CTL-676: tax treatment determined per lease; EWT withheld & VAT/DST filed; reconciled to GL/AP; BIR-audit supported
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax/BIR), VS-15 (AP), VS-17 (GL), VS-100 (legal), W4411 (abstract), W4425 (close), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **WHT-miss risk**: EWT not withheld on rent → disallowance + penalty; mitigated by AP-payment WHT gate
- **DST-miss risk**: DST not filed on lease contract → penalty; mitigated by contract-trigger DST filing
System Touchpoints: - Tax/BIR eFPS (VS-79); lease-accounting (W4427); AP (VS-15); GL (VS-17); BIR forms; audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Tax/Lease Accounting determine the tax treatment per lease — VAT (12%) on residential/commercial rent as applicable, Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT) on rent, Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) on the lease contract, percentage tax considerations
Lease Admin/AP withhold EWT on rent payments, file DST on lease contracts, and remit VAT/EWT via BIR (VS-79); issue/withhold BIR forms (2307)
Tax/Lease Accounting reconcile tax to GL/AP (VS-15/VS-17), support BIR audit (VS-79/VS-21), and update on tax-law change

fields.Participants: Intercompany (VS-72), Lease Admin (VS-42), Treasury (VS-18), AP/AR (VS-15/VS-16), Property Mgmt (VS-97), Consolidation (VS-17)
fields.Trigger: Intercompany lease; monthly settlement; third-party landlord payment
fields.Volume: Intercompany (Property Mgmt → Depot etc.) + third-party landlord settlements

Automation Opportunity: - Intercompany auto-billing & matching; settlement engine; lessee-vs-lessor reconciliation; transfer-pricing validation
Controls: - CTL-676: rent/intercompany processed per transfer pricing; intercompany matched & settled monthly; lessee-vs-lessor reconciled; consolidated
Cross-references: - links to VS-72 (intercompany), VS-15/VS-16 (AP/AR), VS-97 (lessor/RE), VS-18 (treasury), W4414 (liability), W4424 (elimination)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Intercompany-mismatch risk**: lessee & lessor sides differ → settlement/elimination failure; mitigated by monthly match & reconciliation
- **Transfer-pricing risk**: non-arm's-length intercompany rent → tax exposure; mitigated by transfer-pricing policy
System Touchpoints: - Intercompany (VS-72); AP/AR (VS-15/VS-16); lease-accounting (W4427); consolidation (VS-17); treasury (VS-18); lessor/RE (VS-97)

steps.activity: Lease Admin/Intercompany process rent/lease payments to third-party landlords (AP VS-15) and intercompany lease charges between the 5 entities (Property Mgmt as lessor, Depot as lessee) per arm's-length transfer pricing
Intercompany/Consolidation settle intercompany lease balances at month-end, match to the elimination (W4424), and reconcile to intercompany AR/AP (VS-72)
Lease Accounting/Property Mgmt reconcile lessee liability (W4414) to lessor receivable/asset (VS-97), resolve differences, and report consolidated (VS-17)

workflows.name: Lease Portfolio Analytics, Total Cost of Occupancy & Benchmarking

Automation Opportunity: - Lease/occupancy-cost dashboard; cost-per-sqm/%-of-revenue analytics; benchmark import; outlier detection
Controls: - CTL-676 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Administration, Compliance & Optimization Analytics (PA-148.3).)
- CTL-676: analytics complete & reconciled; total-occupancy-cost calculated; benchmarked; outliers actioned; reviewed by Finance/Strategy
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (BI), VS-97 (RE), VS-33 (strategy), VS-17.4 (FP&A), W4425 (close), W4432 (decisions)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Siloed-cost risk**: occupancy cost fragmented across rent/CAM/utilities → obscured; mitigated by total-occupancy-cost view
- **Benchmark-absence risk**: no benchmark → can't judge value; mitigated by industry benchmarking
System Touchpoints: - BI (VS-28); lease-accounting (W4427); RE/portfolio (VS-97); strategy (VS-33); finance FP&A (VS-17.4); treasury (VS-18)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/BI build lease analytics — ROU/liability balances, depreciation/interest expense, total-lease cash outflow, cost per sqm, cost-as-%-of-revenue, by entity/site/category
Real Estate/Finance calculate **total cost of occupancy** (rent + CAM + utilities + property tax + maintenance) per site, benchmark vs retail/home-improvement norms, and identify outliers
Strategy/Finance feed analytics into strategy (VS-33), site decisions (VS-20/VS-97), and lease-vs-buy/renewal decisions (W4432)

fields.Frequency: Per decision (~10–15 store + multiple equipment decisions/yr)
fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), Treasury (VS-18), Capex (VS-40), Strategy (VS-33), Lease Accounting, Tax (VS-79)
fields.Trigger: Lease expiry; new asset need; capex decision; optimization review

workflows.name: Lease vs Buy, Renewal & Optimization Decision Support

Automation Opportunity: - Lease-vs-buy model with PFRS 16 impact; market-rent benchmark; renewal-decision dashboard; benefit-realization tracking
Controls: - CTL-676: structured lease-vs-buy/renewal analysis; market-rent benchmarked; optimization measured; approved by Finance/Strategy
Cross-references: - links to VS-97 (RE), VS-40 (capex), VS-18 (treasury), VS-33 (strategy), VS-42 (lease admin/negotiation), VS-112 (benefit), W4431 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sub-optimal-renewal risk**: auto-renew above market → value leakage; mitigated by market-rent benchmark & analysis
- **Wrong-lease-vs-buy risk**: leasing what should be owned (or vice versa) → higher TCO; mitigated by structured lease-vs-buy model
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting/analytics (W4427/W4431); RE (VS-97); treasury (VS-18); capex (VS-40); strategy (VS-33); finance FP&A (VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Finance/Real Estate build the **lease-vs-buy** analysis — compare PFRS 16 ROU/liability + total-lease-cost vs purchase capex + depreciation + financing + residual, with tax/cash-flow modeling
Finance/Real Estate assess renewal vs relocate vs downsize at expiry — market rent, renewal terms, strategic fit, total occupancy (W4431), and negotiate (VS-42)
Finance/Strategy execute optimization — consolidate sites, renegotiate outliers, right-size space, convert to own (VS-97) where economic — and measure benefit realization (VS-112)
